verdict.rationale: Cognee documents agent-invokable memory operations as single API calls: `remember` to add (including mid-session writes into a session cache), `recall` to search with automatic strategy selection, and `forget` to delete at item, dataset or full scope. An official MCP server lets assistants like Claude, Cursor and Cline call these as tools. Update is only implied: `improve` enriches the graph and bridges session memory into permanent memory, but is not an explicit edit of an existing memory. missing for 10: explicit update/edit-memory operation, documented list of MCP tools showing which operations agents can invoke, independent hands-on corroboration of agent self-managed memory.
